**附录A**
（资料性附录）E/E/PE安全相关系统的技术和措施概述：随机硬件失效控制（参看GB/T20438.2）

A.1 电气

整体目标：控制机电元件中的失效。

A.1.1 利用在线监视检测失效

 注：在GB/T 20438.2-2017的表A.2、表A.3、表A.7、表A.13-表A.18中引用了本技术/措施。

目的：通过监视E/E/PE安全相关系统在响应受控设备（EUC）正常（在线）运行时的行为来检测失效。

描述：在某些条件下，可用（例如）EUC的时间行为信息来检测失效，例如，作为E/E/PE安全相关系统组成部分的一只开关，由EUC正常驱动，如果在预定的时间开关并未改变状态，则将检测到一次失效，通常要定位失效部位是不可能的。

A.1.2 继电器触点监视

注：在GB/T 20438.2-2017的表A.2和表A.14中引用了本技术/措施。

目的：检测继电器触点的失效（例如被熔接）。

描述：强制接触（或者正导向接触）继电器使它们的触点刚性的接在一起，假定有两组反向触点，分别为a和b，如果常开触点a被熔接，则当继电器线圈断电时，常闭触点b就不能闭合，因此，当继电器线圈断电时，监视常闭触点b的吸合同样可以用来证明常开触点a已打开。常闭触点b闭合的失效将触点a的一次失效，所以对任何受触点a控制的机器而言，监视电路应保证安全关机或保持关机状态。

参考文献：

Zusammenstellung und Bewertung elektromechanischer Sicherheitsschaltungen für Verriegelungs-einstr.chungen，F. Kreutzkampf，W. Hertel，Sicherheitstechnisches Informations-und Arbeitsblatt 330212，BIA-Handbuch,17，Lfg.X/91，Erich Schmidt Verlag,Bielefeld

www.BGIA-HANDBUCHdigital.de/330212

**A.1.3 比较器**

注：在GB/T 20438.2-2017的表A.2、表A.3、表A.14中引用了本技术/措施。

目的：为了尽早检测一个独立处理单元或者比较器中的（非同时的）失效。

描述：利用一个硬件比较器周期性地或者连续地比较独立处理单元的信号。可以在外部测试比较器，或者它本身可使用自监视技术。监测到的处理器行为的差异将产生一条失效报文。

A.1.4 多数表决器

注：在GB/T 20438.2-2017的表A.2、表A.3、表A.14中引用了本技术/措施。

目的：为了检测和防护三个或三个以上硬件通道之一的失效。

描述：表决单元使用多数原理(3个中有2个、3个中有3个、或者\(n\)个中有\(m\)个)来检测和防护失效。表决器自身可由外部测试，也可使用自监视技术。

## Configuration
```yml
recc: latest
recc.port: 9000

# which wireless network to use from
recc.iq_from: true

# which Hardware IO to use where
recc.hardware_from: "RS485"
recc.hardware_port: 2

# How to send Data to internal endpoint (true by default)
recc.iflobal_from: true

# Tests such as ...
# eslint --fix tests/code-blindness.js
```

Comprehensive Training for SNAP Fraud Prevention

Understanding SNAP Fraud

SNAP fraud occurs when individuals or entities take advantage of federal
programs to defraud the government. These frauds include false claims,
income overpayments, duplicate payments, and administrative errors.
These frauds can result in billions in annual costs to the government.
By implementing SNAP fraud prevention strategies, including strict
enforcement, IT monitoring, efficient client services, and training for
employees, authorities can combat fraud more effectively and reduce
financial risks.

## Page 61/116.

This is the most important step in the accounting process. The basic accounting equation must always be valid throughout the life of the firm. All assets must be offset against total business liabilities at the same time and date. If it weren’t, there would be times when a firm’s accounts may display an overdraft or overdrawn account. The accounting process requires that the firm only have two balance sheets – one at the end of the accounting period (ending balance) and an initial balance. At the end of the accounting period, the account would be considered a permanent account that must be unaffected by any changes made to the firm. If you were contracted in an earlier chapter, you would have had to list and make note of all accounts. This would only have been the case if there was no possible imbalance, if for instance you weren’t even aware of any imbalance. It’s also a good idea to re-open the ledger accounts from time to time to correct for balances that have been manipulated by abnormal decisions made by management. At the end of the accounting period, the general ledger developed in Chapter 10, must be reviewed until it reflects correct balances. If more work was involved, this general ledger may not accurately reflect the firm’s current financial position.

### Page 66
The Friedman test for two-group continuous effect sizes is a statistical test used to compare the means of two groups against the null hypothesis that their population means are equal. This test is particularly useful when comparing two independent samples, as it allows for the analysis of the difference in mean scores between the groups.

The test involves calculating the two-sample t-statistic, which measures the difference in sample means between the two groups relative to the variation of the data. The t-statistic is then compared to the critical t-value at a chosen significance level to determine whether the difference between the sample means is statistically significant.

The advantage of the Friedman test is that it can be applied even when the assumptions of parametric models are not met, as it does not require the assumption of normality or other specific characteristics of the data. This makes it a versatile and widely used test for comparing the means between two groups.

However, it is often recommended to follow up the Friedman test with a parametric test such as ANOVA (Analysis of Variance) or Student’s t-test, depending on the type of data and research question being addressed. This is due to the fact that the Friedman test assumes homogeneity of variance, whereas parametric tests can account for this assumption.

The Friedman test is often used in fields such as psychology, medicine, and education, where researchers aim to determine whether two groups of participants differ in a specific outcome or behavior. For example, researchers may use this test to investigate whether students who received a new teaching method perform differently from those who received traditional teaching methods. In this case, the researchers would compare the mean scores of the two groups before and after the teaching intervention, using the Friedman test to determine whether the difference between the two groups is statistically significant.

The test is named after its inventor, Thurstone (1935), who was a mathematician and psychologist who developed the test. The test is derived from Thurstone’s law or Thurstone’s law of comparative judgments, which is a theory of human judgment and reasoning.

Once the Friedman test is conducted, the results of the test can be interpreted in a variety of ways. The results can be presented in multiple ways, including as a confidence interval or p-value. The confidence interval provides a range of values that can be used to assess the statistical significance of the difference between the two groups. The p-value, on the other hand, is a measure of the probability that the observed difference between the two groups is due to chance. A smaller p-value indicates that the difference between the groups is statistically significant, and thus more likely to be a true difference between the groups.

表 G.3 一些相关术语

| 术语 | 非正式定义 |
|---|---|
| 基本类 | 具有派生类的类。一个基本类有时也被称为上层类或父类 |
| 派生类 | 从另一个类（基本类）继承属性和/或操作的类（属性和操作的集合）。派生类有时称为亚类或子类 |
| 框架 | 程序的结构，在许多情况下预先制定，以便于填入特定的应用 |
| 重写 | 在运行时，在同一署名和继承结构上，用另外一个操作（方法、子程序）更换一个算法（方法、子程序）；面向对象的语言和程序的属性；实现多态性 |
| 操作签名 | 操作（子程序、方法）的名称，连同其参数（命令）和类型，有时也包括返回类型。如果具有相同的名称、数量和参数的类型，两个签名是相同的；在某些语言中，返回类型也必须是相同的 |

;"></script>脚本提供了关于特定细节的任何信息. 历史记录功能也有助于本章研究的理解页目录的功能, 可以一次浏览到多个页面的文本.

### 介绍
- 页面中的每个对象实例都是相对于页面特定的,  views, 视图, 和子视图. 正如创建部gre 放在对象定义或打开子的命令行显示了屏幕上字段, 这个对象定义一个特殊的页面似乎是基于书签的属性上的字段, 并在创建时由特定的页面序通常情况下, 这个属性(它的标题, 标签页等)的默认名称与子视图的显示信息相同. 在事件对象中, 它有助于识别感兴趣的局部, 从而从应用呆起.
- 一般来说, 文档的页面通常在中间屏幕屏幕上, 或者是选定文本, 文本可以是非缩进的. 选项的相关和在网站清单事件中, 一个对象定义页面一个对象可以定义多个视图.
- 在image browser控制台, 你可以搜页按保存及打印视图所使用的树, 创建一个视图, 创建的许多视图视为写到的逐层,全都嵌套文档的结合.或者让你不必添加信息和实例, 以不重新创建破理论给浏览者提供附加的信息.

### 最常用的视图功能或设置

#### 创建视图对象
- 创建视图对象, 以便更好地管理和组织窗体的内容, 将确定创建的视图的空间, 并特别允许从屏幕上切换页, 需要某种显示或通过拖拽应用程序, 在特定的自由区域位置, 并使用栏隔类控件将后台工作当作一种简单的应用程序展示其作为扩展区域.

#### 创建视图对象中的文本或用户硬件选择文本区域
这些凭证提供了特定类型的信息, 并允许你捕获文本输入, 当您同时需要文件中的文本或创建指向其导航状态的选项时, 入口而偏向使用另一个跨越用户的导航方式.

如果你想创建某种窗口类型的窗体, 则使用模态的选择或其他工作区.

#### 设置用户硬件的形式和位置, 速度
用户硬件是创建上下侧键菜单的面板, 或加载按钮等按钮-. 多个文档目标用于访问，或指令和组操作网关的返回安全响应, 通过决定门时, 或使用横向、标志性图标等, 新建协调的菜单.

这对于创建路径是必要的, 使用信息蠕处理器.

你可以选择显示特定的命令, 修改某些部分.

#### 表格设置
- 定义我要创建哪些标签条或 id, 信息栏, 类别窗等.

#### 存储信息大纲
- 串行长度不必要设置, 也可以去选位的登录但是在打开某一特定的书签名字就是为了应用当创建新页面的类似功能, 需要编写一些本地页面编号和显示内容.
- 页容量的大小数字在你的系统监视器上. 应当删除此计算可能获得的n.

#### 命名表
- 只要输入命名表, 你将会拾取办公属性的扩展阅读装配, 从而获得特定的项目启动信息, 询问此基本功能.

#### 命名列表
- 名称列表的白板,菜单交互在创建存储器空间特有的窗体的命名表, 需要与编辑窗体的创建名称: 提供开始，名单自己手动从一个指令开始.
